==Lithuanian==

===Etymology===
Appears to be a new formation built from ''mãn-'', the oblique stem of {{m|lt|àš}} + the masculine genitive ending {{m|lt|-õ}}; compare {{m|lt|jõ|t=his}}, {{m|lt|tàvo|t=your}}, {{m|lt|sàvo|t=one's own}}. Dialectal {{m|lt|mãnas|t=my}} matches {{cog|lv|mans|t=my}}, while {{cog|prg|mais|t=my}} is an independent formation. Compare, however, {{cog|xsv|mano|t=my}}, which suggests the formation may be old.
